text:
lina: Heads up — planning a night cordon for the quant-kernel rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Main checklist: deploy script, release notes, artifact pin TTL, rollback command. Can people call dibs?
ashwin: I can own rollback runbook + smoke tests. Will add thresholds.
sam: Need exact artifact name/label for Dedicated pinning and release notes.
lina: artifact = `redwood/engine:quant-kernel-v13-2026-03-21`. Suggest pin TTL = 2h for night bucket.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job created -> env=eng-runtime-prod-night, start=2026-03-21T23:00:00Z, owner=@lina
maria: Staged rollout please: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with 15m dwell and perf check gates. Enable KV-cache fallback as a safety net. :lock_with_ink_pen:
ashwin: Agreed. Acceptance gates: p99 latency < 120ms, global error rate < 0.1%, no matmul OOMs. If any gate fails, rollback to `quant-kernel-v12`.
ops-oncall: Ops ack. Make rollback command ready in chatops: e.g. ` /deploy rollback redwood/engine:quant-kernel-v12 --reason "night-cordon gate trip" ` and add a short runbook link. I'll monitor GPU thermal and memory dashboards.
sam: For Dedicated pools, pin label = `engine:quant-v13.pin=night-2026-03-21`. Will add to provisioning script.
lina: Release notes draft (short): "quant-kernel v13 — matmul kernel refactor + int8 qconv paths. Expected 20-30% per-token cost reduction for long context. Monitor thermal/precision regressions"
kevin: I'll run a full 512-seq synthetic preflight in staging at 20:00 UTC (throughput + perf + OOM). Will paste results here by 21:30.
maria: Add a canary correctness check: logits-diff on sample evalset `release-check-v13` and a small metric: mean token delta < 0.01. If exceeded, halt.
ashwin: I'll wire a temporary telemetry gate: cohort A vs B BLEU-like delta threshold = 0.02; also watch for increase in repetition rate.
deploy-bot: deploy started -> cohort=canary size=5% artifact=redwood/engine:quant-kernel-v13-2026-03-21 ts=5570009400
lina: If any gate trips, rollback immediately and ping #incidents + @ops-oncall. Keep comms short: "rollback initiated: reason=<gate>".
ops-oncall: Linking dashboards: grafana/d/eng-runtime/quant-kernel-night?orgId=1 (watch p99, OOMs, GPU thermal). I'll post alerts into this thread.
maria: Post-deploy chores: flip telemetry sample to store logits for 1h and run eval job; bump rollout to 25% only after green.
ashwin: I'll prepare a minimal postmortem template in the doc if we need it: owners = @ashwin (kernel), @sam (packaging), @lina (rollout ops).
sam: Packaging note: build includes a tiny checksum change — will include sha256 in release note and prod artifact registry entry.
lina: Thanks all. Final go/no-go check by 22:30 UTC. I'll open a release note PR and tag reviewers. :rocket:
